q1.explanationZh: 第一段说 Spanky 六岁、Roman 八岁，所以 Roman 比 Spanky 大两岁。

evidence.quote: Spanky is six years old and Roman is eight.

q2.explanationZh: 前一句说 Roman 的耳朵肿了，所以兽医说有耳朵问题的是 Roman。

q3.explanationZh: 文中说装摄像头是为了主人不在家时也能留意狗狗。

q4.explanationZh: 最后一段说 Roman 做完手术，现在好多了。

evidence.quote: Now, Roman has had his operation and he is doing much better.

q5.explanationZh: 友谊感动了很多人（①对），从小狗时就开始（③对）；不止几周（②错），也没有因生病结束（④错）。

evidence.quote: have been good friends since they were

q6.explanationZh: because of 是介词，后面要名词，sick 的名词形式是 sickness。

evidence.quote: he was sick with ear problems

q7.explanationZh: your 后面要名词，decide 变成名词 decision。

evidence.quote: his owners decided to set up a video

q8.explanationZh: 这里修饰 seated（动词形式），要用副词 comfortably。

evidence.quote: so that Roman would be more comfortable

q9.explanationZh: Would you mind 后面接动词 -ing，所以用 sharing。

evidence.quote: The owners shared the video on the

q10.explanationZh: The first thing I ... 讲过去的事，用一般过去时 noticed。

q11.explanationZh: 后面 she went 是过去式，所以用一般过去时 waited。

q12.explanationZh: 划线部分表示一段时间，用 How long 来提问。

evidence.quote: have been good friends since they were

q13.explanationZh: so that 可以换成 in order that，意思都是“为了”。

evidence.quote: Spanky brought his bed to Roman so that Roman would be more comfortable

q14.explanationZh: 被动语态用 be done by：Many people were moved by ...。

evidence.quote: The friendship between Spanky and Roman

q15.explanationZh: 先找主句 I asked a lady to keep an eye on my bag，再接 when I was away 说明时间。
